prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: concept product workspace illustration for an academic PowerPoint about SimuNow, an indoor AC room configuration and analysis tool. The slide will explicitly label this as a planned interface.
Primary request: render one clean Mac desktop application window, front-on, on a seamless pure white background. Do not render a computer body, keyboard, screen stand or mobile devices.
Composition: wide landscape 2:1 aspect ratio. The application window fills 94% of the image, with a subtle soft grey shadow and generous clean edges. It has a thin macOS title bar and three panes: narrow object navigation on the left, a large central room model viewport, a modest inspector on the right.
Central subject: a crisp isometric architectural cutaway of one rectangular office with a window, three desks and chairs, furniture, occupied seat markers without people, and one clearly visible wall-mounted split AC unit. Fine graphite outlines, white and pale grey surfaces, subdued cyan window glass. Highlight only the AC selection in muted teal. No airflow field.
Left pane: minimal readable object list with the exact labels "Room", "Furniture", "Seats", "AC".
Right pane: simple inspector with exact labels "AC settings", "Placement", "Direction", "Airflow", "Setpoint". Use blank input rows without numerical values. No sliders that imply performance outputs.
Top title text exactly "SimuNow". Central pane heading exactly "Room model". Otherwise keep interface text minimal.
Style: refined light macOS productivity app concept, precise architectural illustration, white and charcoal grey with restrained teal (#277F89) accents. Visually cohesive with an academic white slide, no colourful dashboard or card grid.
Constraints: this is a conceptual UI, not an actual screenshot or computed result. No charts, temperatures, power or cost numbers, percentages, PMV values, result panels, heat maps, streamlines, saving claims, fake run successes or simulation status. No marketing text, logos besides the specified word, watermarks or decorative graphics. Sharp, professional, legible composition.
scope: Planned interface concept only. Not an actual application screenshot, numerical result or implemented analysis capability.
